//! Rustdoc fixture for the facade surface inspection.
//!
//! Every item here places a foreign type in one signature position the
//! inspection must read. See <https://docs.rs/serde_json> for the crate this
//! prose deliberately links to without disclosing anything.

/// A struct with a foreign type in a public field, an argument, and a return.
pub struct Positions {
    /// A public field whose type is foreign.
    pub retained: serde_json::Value,
}

impl Positions {
    /// Takes a foreign type as an argument.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn accept(value: &serde_json::Value) -> Self {
        Self {
            retained: value.clone(),
        }
    }

    /// Returns a foreign type.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn produce(&self) -> serde_json::Value {
        self.retained.clone()
    }
}

/// A trait with a foreign associated type and a foreign bound.
pub trait Bounded {
    /// An associated type that is foreign.
    type Document: Into<serde_json::Value>;

    /// A method whose bound names a foreign type.
    fn describe<T: AsRef<serde_json::Value>>(&self, value: T) -> usize;
}
